mapper.delete: delete from risk_check_task where id in #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_check_task WHERE task_status != 2 AND due_date < CURDATE()
SELECT task_status as taskStatus, COUNT(*) as count FROM risk_check_task GROUP BY task_status ORDER BY task_status
select t.*, c.company_name from risk_check_task t left join risk_company c on t.company_id = c.id where t.assignee_id = #{userId} and t.task_status in (0, 1) order by t.due_date asc limit #{limit}
